data.narrative:
Guardian RF is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Lucas Raskin, Eli Kerstein, and John Andrzejewski that has raised $4.1M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 4 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage companies spanning both public equities (2 names) and private companies (8 names), including Stark Defence, UFORCE, Singularity, and NODA AI, with valuations ranging from $125M to $4.0B.

Two triangulation methods apply to Guardian RF. Stage-progression methodology applies a standard 2.5x step-up multiplier to the $4M raised proxy, implying a $10M valuation consistent with Seed-to-next-stage dynamics. Peer-median analysis across the 4-company comp set yields a $700M median valuation, reflecting the wide dispersion typical of early-stage defense-tech valuations. The latter method carries higher weight given market heterogeneity.

The triangulated valuation range spans $9M (low) to $805M (median/high), with a midpoint of $355M. This wide band reflects material uncertainty inherent in Seed-stage valuation, particularly the significant gap between stage-progression mechanics and peer comps. Key sensitivities include: relative technology differentiation versus peers like UFORCE (valued at $1.0B at Seed), customer traction, and defensibility in a crowded defense-tech landscape. Near-term fundraising activity and customer wins will be critical to narrowing this range.
